newsitem.title: USA: Muni sales total $1.5 bln for the week of March 31.
newsitem.headline: Muni sales total $1.5 bln for the week of March 31.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of March 31 are expected to total $1.5 billion in 73 sales, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $1.3 billion in 40 sales, with a $231 million Delaware County, Pa., Industrial Development Authority deal through Goldman, Sachs & Co. topping the the list.
On the competitive side, 33 sales totaling $210 million are on the schedule, a $29 million Broome County, N.Y., deal is the largest.
An additional seven sales totaling $388 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the bonds next week, depending on market conditions.
